recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Berries
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds and honey together in a bowl or two jars.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Stir in a splash of milk if too thick, then top with the berries and serve cold.

recipes.title: Veggie Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with the salt. Halve the tomatoes and crumble the feta.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the spinach and tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and let them set for 2 minutes, lifting the edges so raw egg runs underneath.
Scatter over the feta, fold the omelette in half and slide onto plates.

recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash one banana in a bowl, then whisk in the eggs and milk.
Add the flour and baking powder and stir until just combined; a few lumps are fine.
Heat a little butter in a pan over medium heat. Pour in small ladlefuls of batter.
Cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear, flip and cook 1 minute more.
Serve stacked with sliced banana and maple syrup.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
steps: Slice the chicken into strips and season with salt.
Fry in the olive oil over medium-high heat for 6 to 7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Shred the lettuce and grate the parmesan.
Toss chicken, lettuce and half the parmesan with the dressing.
Divide among the wraps, roll up tightly and slice in half.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Dice the onion and mince the garlic. Soften them in the olive oil over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Add the canned tomatoes, stock, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Add most of the basil leaves and blend until smooth with an immersion blender.
Taste, adjust the seasoning and serve with the remaining basil.

recipes.title: Chickpea Greek Salad
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Chop the cucumber, halve the tomatoes and thinly slice the onion.
Combine everything in a large bowl with the olives.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with oregano and toss gently.
Crumble the feta over the top and serve.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion and carrot and mince the garlic.
Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the beef over high heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the onion, carrot and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, canned tomatoes and oregano. Simmer on low for 35 minutes, stirring now and then.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, then drain.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and serve with grated parmesan.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken & Potato Sheet Pan
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Halve the potatoes and mince the garlic.
Toss the potatoes, chicken, garlic, oregano, salt, olive oil and the juice of one lemon on a large sheet pan.
Roast for 25 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets and the second lemon in wedges. Roast 15 minutes more until the chicken is golden and cooked through.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve straight from the pan.

recipes.title: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Press the tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes, then cut into cubes.
Fry the tofu in the sesame oil over high heat for 6 minutes until crisp. Set aside.
Stir-fry the carrots and broccoli for 4 minutes, then add the peppers, ginger and garlic for 2 minutes.
Return the tofu, add the soy sauce and toss for 1 minute. Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Broccoli & Rice
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Start the rice according to the packet.
Place the salmon and broccoli on a lined tray. Add the oil, minced garlic, salt and the juice of half the lemon.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Serve with the rice and the remaining lemon in wedges.

recipes.title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
steps: Dice the onion. Soften it in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and drained chickpeas. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the packet.
Stir the spinach into the curry until wilted. Season to taste and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Warm the oil in a pan, add the drained beans and cumin, and cook for 8 minutes, mashing some of the beans.
Mash the avocados with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt.
Dice the onion and tomatoes; grate the cheddar.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill with beans, guacamole, tomatoes, onion and cheese. Serve with lime wedges.

Your Recipes note is now a recipe and meal planning app, with twelve seeded recipes and this week's plan (Mon 5 – Sun 11 Oct). I could only preview it over generic sample data, because previews of your real notes are switched off. I haven't opened the seeded recipes, plan or shopping list in the app, and I haven't tried the editor or cooking mode.

- **Recipes:** the library has search (by title, tag or ingredient) and tag chips. Each recipe has a servings stepper that rescales the ingredients, shown with fractions like ½ and ¾. You can add, edit and delete recipes. A Cook button opens cooking mode.
- **Cooking mode:** it's full screen and shows one step at a time in large text, with big Back and Next buttons. An Ingredients toggle shows the scaled ingredients, and the app asks the device to keep the screen on.
- **Plan:** each day has breakfast, lunch and dinner slots. Tap "Add" to pick a recipe. Recipes tagged for that meal are listed first. You can move between weeks.
- **Shopping:** it adds up the viewed week's ingredients across recipes when name and unit match, grouped by aisle. Each item shows which recipes it's for. Items are checkable, you can add your own items (two are seeded), and "Clear done" removes ticked items.

The seeded recipes are oats, omelette, pancakes, Caesar wraps, tomato soup, Greek salad, bolognese, lemon chicken, tofu stir-fry, salmon, chickpea curry and black bean tacos.

The preview checker flagged low contrast on the orange accent buttons and chips, and the tab-bar labels as small. Both come from the app's built-in theme, and I didn't change them.

The app's data shape is documented in the note's README.

Fry the tofu in the sesame oil over high heat for 6 minutes until crisp. Set aside.
Stir-fry the carrots and broccoli for 4 minutes, then add the peppers, ginger and garlic for 2 minutes.
Return the tofu, add the soy sauce and toss for 1 minute. Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Broccoli & Rice
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Start the rice according to the packet.
Place the salmon and broccoli on a lined tray. Add the oil, minced garlic, salt and the juice of half the lemon.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Serve with the rice and the remaining lemon in wedges.

recipes.title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
steps: Dice the onion. Soften it in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and drained chickpeas. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the packet.
Stir the spinach into the curry until wilted. Season to taste and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Warm the oil in a pan, add the drained beans and cumin, and cook for 8 minutes, mashing some of the beans.
Mash the avocados with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt.
Dice the onion and tomatoes; grate the cheddar.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill with beans, guacamole, tomatoes, onion and cheese. Serve with lime wedges.
